cards.title: Play School Back: Quality TV for Toddlers
cards.body: Play School returns as a refreshing alternative to overstimulating children's programming. Parents appreciate shows designed to genuinely benefit development rather than grab attention like smartphones.

cards.title: Sleepover Safety: The Secret Codeword Strategy
cards.body: Establish a discreet codeword so children can signal distress at sleepovers without embarrassment. This simple tool helps kids communicate they need to go home without losing face.

cards.title: Working Parents: School Holidays Logistics
cards.body: School holiday timing creates genuine logistical challenges for working parents juggling childcare and careers. Better coordination could transform holidays into meaningful family time rather than survival mode.

cards.title: Harsh Words Damage Children's Self-Esteem
cards.body: Careless parental comments may be forgotten quickly by adults but can impact children's self-esteem for years. Parents should recognize how their words shape their child's sense of self-worth.

cards.title: Improve Stepchild Relationships Through Action
cards.body: Stepchildren often become more receptive when they observe tangible improvements in family life from a stepparent. Actions speak louder than forced bonding attempts.

cards.title: Adult Children's Health Decline: Processing Emotions
cards.body: Adult children from dysfunctional families may face complex emotional layers when a parent becomes seriously ill. Professional support helps navigate grief, relief, guilt, and unresolved family dynamics simultaneously.

cards.title: Fall Routines Support Parent Recovery
cards.body: Back-to-school routines create space for parents to reconnect with identity, career, and personal recovery. The structure benefits whole-family mental health.

cards.title: Spotting Abuser Tactics in Custody Battles
cards.body: Domestic abusers follow predictable legal scripts designed to discredit the other parent in custody disputes. Recognizing these patterns helps protect children and strengthen cases.
